{"test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection3", "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection3\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task GeneratedUnionFormatterAndResolverHaveExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TestNamespace\n{\n    [Union(0, typeof(SubTypeA))]\n    [Union(1, typeof(SubTypeB))]\n    public interface IMyUnion\n    {\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class SubTypeA : IMyUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int ValueA { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class SubTypeB : IMyUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public string ValueB { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80References = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> references = net80References.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(output.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? unionType = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.IMyUnion\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? openFormatterInterface = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter`1\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverInterface = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.IFormatterResolver\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n\n        Assert.NotNull(unionType);\n        Assert.NotNull(openFormatterInterface);\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverInterface);\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol unionFormatterInterface = openFormatterInterface!.Construct(unionType!);\n\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> allTypes = GetAllTypes(output.Assembly.GlobalNamespace).ToList();\n\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> unionFormatters = allTypes\n            .Where(t => t.AllInterfaces.Contains(unionFormatterInterface, SymbolEqualityComparer.Default))\n            .ToList();\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> resolvers = allTypes\n            .Where(t => t.AllInterfaces.Contains(resolverInterface, SymbolEqualityComparer.Default))\n            .ToList();\n\n        Assert.NotEmpty(unionFormatters);\n        Assert.NotEmpty(resolvers);\n\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol unionFormatter in unionFormatters)\n        {\n            AssertHasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(unionFormatter, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr!);\n        }\n\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol resolver in resolvers)\n        {\n            AssertHasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(resolver, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr!);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void AssertHasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(INamedTypeSymbol typeSymbol, INamedTypeSymbol excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr)\n    {\n        bool hasAttributeSymbol = typeSymbol.GetAttributes()\n            .Any(a => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(a.AttributeClass, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr));\n        Assert.True(hasAttributeSymbol, $\"Generated type '{typeSymbol.ToDisplayString()}' is missing ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute.\");\n\n        bool hasAttributeSyntax = typeSymbol.DeclaringSyntaxReferences\n            .Select(r => r.GetSyntax())\n            .OfType<TypeDeclarationSyntax>()\n            .Any(t => t.AttributeLists.Any(al => al.ToString().Contains(\"global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage\", StringComparison.Ordinal)));\n        Assert.True(hasAttributeSyntax, $\"Generated type '{typeSymbol.ToDisplayString()}' syntax does not carry [global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n    }\n\n    private static IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> GetAllTypes(INamespaceOrTypeSymbol root)\n    {\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in root.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            yield return type;\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in GetAllTypes(type))\n            {\n                yield return nested;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (root is INamespaceSymbol ns)\n        {\n            foreach (INamespaceSymbol childNs in ns.GetNamespaceMembers())\n            {\n                foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in GetAllTypes(childNs))\n                {\n                    yield return type;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n"}
